Giddy up! Heroic horsewomen ride again - in pictures

Three projects: You Forgot to See Me Coming, Hidden in Plain Sight and Intimate Justice by Ayana V Jackson are being shown in her solo exhibition at the Arles Gallery. Photograph: Christopher Garcia/Ayana V Jackson
